# mimux

> A self-hosted email gateway: connect any IMAP mailbox and reach it through
> every interface — a fast, free web client (AGPL-3.0) for humans, and a paid
> automation layer (REST API, MCP server, CLI, signed webhooks; GraphQL on the
> roadmap) for scripts and AI agents. One Go binary, one SQLite file, on your
> own hardware (€49/yr or €99 perpetual, per instance, 14-day free trial).

Current release: v0.23.0. Install is one command — either
`docker run -d --name mimux -p 8083:8083 -v mimux-data:/data ghcr.io/mattmezza/mimux:latest`,
or `curl -fsSL https://mimux.dev/install.sh | bash` (add `-s -- pro` for the
automation layer). Zero configuration; the first visit creates the admin user.

## Pages

- [Features](https://mimux.dev/features/): unified inbox, IMAP IDLE sync of the folders you choose, deep search, Markdown compose with undo-send and IMAP-backed drafts, server-side filters, PWA with encrypted push.
- [Automation & APIs](https://mimux.dev/agents/): the MCP server at /api/mcp, the REST API with OpenAPI spec, the `mimux mail` CLI, signed webhooks, scoped tokens, two-step sending.
- [Pricing](https://mimux.dev/pricing/): free client forever; pro €49/yr or €99 perpetual per instance; offline Ed25519 licence verification, no phone-home.
- [About](https://mimux.dev/about/): built by Matteo Merola (Merola Software & Services, Zurich); the published free/pro line and why it can't move.
- [Security](https://mimux.dev/security/): how to report vulnerabilities privately, scope, and mimux's security posture.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://docs.mimux.dev): the index — what to read first, and the free/pro split in one paragraph.
- [How mimux works](https://docs.mimux.dev/how-it-works/): the model, what a sync cycle covers, what mimux is not, IMAP-backed drafts.
- [Installation](https://docs.mimux.dev/install/): Docker and the one-line installer, image tags, environment variables, OAuth, HTTPS, upgrading, backup.
- [Web UI, PWA and notifications](https://docs.mimux.dev/interfaces/): keyboard shortcuts, installing as an app, Web Push and ntfy.
- [Command line](https://docs.mimux.dev/cli/): every subcommand — `mimux upgrade`, `mimux completion`, and the pro `mimux mail`, `mimux mcp`, `mimux licence status`.
- [The automation layer](https://docs.mimux.dev/automation/): API tokens, scopes, rate limits, the licence key and the trial. Read before the API.
- [REST API guide](https://docs.mimux.dev/api/): auth, envelopes, pagination, idempotency and the common flows, in prose.
- [API reference](https://docs.mimux.dev/reference/): the generated OpenAPI reference — every endpoint and field, served by the binary at /api/v1/openapi.json.
- [MCP server](https://docs.mimux.dev/mcp/): streamable HTTP at /api/mcp or the stdio bridge; nine tools, gated by the token's scopes.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.mimux.dev/webhooks/): events, HMAC-SHA256 signatures, the retry ladder, auto-disable, the delivery log with replay, and local forwarding for development.
- [Architecture](https://docs.mimux.dev/architecture/): sync, storage, threading, search, filters, and the build-tag split between client and pro layer.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mattmezza/mimux): the full source, AGPL-3.0 client plus the ELv2 pro layer.
- [LICENSING.md](https://github.com/mattmezza/mimux/blob/main/LICENSING.md): which directory is under which licence, and how `make verify-free` proves the split.
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/mattmezza/mimux/blob/main/skills/mimux-cli/SKILL.md): teaches a coding agent to drive the CLI — install with `npx skills add mattmezza/mimux --skill mimux-cli`.

## Purchase

- [Account portal](https://account.mimux.dev): licence purchase (Stripe) and key retrieval by email.
